text:
deploy-bot: planned enable: `helix-7b-v3` in catalog at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z (change window). Canary rollout 5% -> 25% over 20m. fallback ordering is changing to latency-first ladder. rollback triggers set (see below).
deploy-bot: ops checklist:\n• pin existing stable variant `helix-7b-v2` to 100% for warmup\n• enable canary 5% (region: us-west-2)\n• observe latency/error telemetry 10m\n• promote to 25% if healthy\n• auto-fallback to `helix-7b-v2` on trigger\n
alex: quick q — what's the exact rollback condition? i saw a note but can't find it.
mira: rollback = any of: error_rate > 3x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 10m OR user-facing failures > 1% in canary traffic.
qa-jen: adding: also fail if decode error rate > 0.5% (we saw hallucination decode issues in last contig).

devops-liz: tagging the routing team: changing fallback ordering from weight-based precedence to latency-first means requests will try lower-latency variants first — this affects cold-start behavior. @sam do we have warm KV cache plan?
sam: yes — we'll pre-warm primary KV caches in the pinned v2 instances 30m before canary start. running: `infratool warm --model helix-7b-v2 --regions us-west-2` now.

alex: note for release notes — mention that fallback ladder now respects observed p50 latency ordering, not static variant priority. customers with pinned versions unaffected.
mira: +1 on notes. add rollback telemetry dashboard link: https://console.redwood/telemetry/helix-7b-v3-canary

deploy-bot: deploy command queued:
```
/deploy enable-model --model=helix-7b-v3 --canary=5,25 --pin=helix-7b-v2:100 --change-window=2026-03-21T02:00Z --fallback=latency-first --rollback=err>3x,p95>2x,decode>0.5%
```

devops-liz: suggest safety hold at +5m if any region shows >10% traffic rejection due to mismatch. We'll watch load balancer 502/504 counts.

qa-jen: running a small smoke job across samples now (100 prompts) to catch immediate decode regressions.

alex: if canary passes, what's the pin strategy for the next 24h? auto-promote to 100% or staged increments?
mira: staged increments: 25% -> 50% after 1h if stable -> 100% after 3h. but we'll keep `helix-7b-v2` pinned for 6h as a fallback anchor.

sam: FYI — routing policy will honor customer pins; we won't override customer pins during this rollout. documented in the notes.

devops-liz: putting an ops page watch: I'll be on-call during window with @sam and @mira. if anything looks bad, react with :rotating_light: and we'll hit manual rollback.

alex: got it. leaving a short blurb for internal release notes: "Model helix-7b-v3 enabled with latency-first fallback ladder; canary staged 5->25->50->100 with rollback thresholds. Pre-warm KV cache and pinned v2 fallback for 6h."
mira: locking this decision for the window. holding manual approval until 5m before start. :eyes:
deploy-bot: ack — will post status updates in-thread during rollout and send final completion/rollback notice.
